title: Constraints on Kaniadakis Cosmology from Starobinsky Inflation and Primordial Tensor Perturbations
efc_relevance: Kaniadakis-entropy cosmology constrained at the inflationary/primordial-tensor end; complements arXiv:2604.19545 (BBN bound on generalised horizon entropies) by pinning the same entropy-class family from the high-z floor. Bounds EFC's L0/L1 boundary if the EFC entropic action shares the κ-deformation limit.
ledger_action: Add to Validation Ledger as L0/L1-regime constraint; cross-reference framework:KaniadakisHDE-Drepanou2021 and arXiv:2604.19545; require EFC L1 prediction to remain consistent with the joint (n_s, r, κ) bound.
